scope: Rolling Ball Interception LeWM+CEM task adapter

cem.episode_reset_rng: reset native solver.torch_gen to seed1234 with env_ids [0], alongside warm-start state
cem.sampler_and_update: unmodified pinned solver; native candidate-zero, torch.topk, unbiased std
cem.warm_start: previous solve action sequence shifted by one as native policy

observations.proprioception: current joints only for command conversion; not ball or task state

goal_cost.source: last available fixed-camera pre-step observation from each of the 180 training episodes only
goal_cost.criterion: minimum terminal latent MSE across fixed training goal bank
goal_cost.cache: frozen goal embeddings at server startup; current observation still encoded in native rollout
goal_cost.terminal_success_labels: not individually verified in published dataset
goal_cost.adaptation: task uses random lanes, so goal bank replaces a single target image

actions.returned_actions: first projected and denormalized command only
actions.projection: train target min/max, used identically for cost rollout and returned actions; constant dimensions fixed
actions.bounds_claim: demonstration envelope; not a hardware safety certification
actions.pending_action: hold most recent absolute joint target; initial hold uses reset joints

required_measurements: full server planner wall time including preprocessing and all CEM rounds
CEM solve wall time with CUDA synchronization
client observation-capture to first-action-application wall and simulation age
actual RTF and native task success in future closed-loop evaluator
evidence_boundary: offline HTTP/CEM smoke and training loss are not closed-loop success or real-time evidence
